policy.sameConcept: Use only when two maintained records represent the same scientific concept. The source record remains independently addressable; its destination is added to the canonical concept.
policy.contextOnly: Use when a maintained object is a meaningful occurrence or application context of a concept but is not another definition of that concept.
policy.keepSeparate: Scientifically related concepts remain distinct canonical concepts and must never be merged merely because their terminology overlaps.

sameConcept.reason: F011 is the Mathematical Formulations record for automatic-differentiation derivatives.
F028 is the continuous weak residual statement and is the dedicated weak-form formulation record.
F031 is the dedicated variational stationarity / energy-minimum formulation record.
F052 is the Fourier feature map used as the same representation concept.
F053 is the sinusoidal representation network (SIREN) formulation.
F106 is the Mathematical Formulations definition of relative L2 field error.
F107 is the Mathematical Formulations definition of root-mean-square error.
F108 is the Mathematical Formulations definition of mean absolute error.

keepSeparate.reason: RMSE and MSE are different metrics with different scale and mathematical definitions.
Weak and variational formulations can overlap in some methods but are not universally identical concepts.
SIREN is an architecture/representation using sinusoidal activations; generic sine activation is not itself the SIREN architecture.
F042 deliberately combines automatic and numerical differentiation and is not identical to pure automatic differentiation.
